from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0]
                 for c in range(w)]

    common_row_mode = Counter(row_modes).most_common(1)[0][0]
    common_col_mode = Counter(col_modes).most_common(1)[0][0]

    line_rows = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_modes) if color != common_row_mode]
    line_cols = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_modes) if color != common_col_mode]

    if not line_rows or not line_cols:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    intersections = [grid[r][c] for r in line_rows for c in line_cols]
    line_color = Counter(intersections).most_common(1)[0][0]

    marked = [(r, c) for r in line_rows for c in line_cols
              if grid[r][c] != line_color]
    if not marked:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    rmin = min(r for r, c in marked)
    rmax = max(r for r, c in marked)
    cmin = min(c for r, c in marked)
    cmax = max(c for r, c in marked)

    rows = [r for r in line_rows if rmin <= r <= rmax]
    cols = [c for c in line_cols if cmin <= c <= cmax]

    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in line_rows
                for c in range(w) if c not in line_cols]
    fill = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0] if interior else line_color

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = (
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            )
            color = corners[0]
            if color != line_color and all(v == color for v in corners):
                out_row.append(color)
            else:
                out_row.append(fill)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
